title: HDF5 port issue

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
Trying to install the hdf5 (tested both x64-windows and x86-windows) port does not seem to work. There are issues trying to locate zlib and szip packages (even though they are installed). I'm trying to build on Windows 7 x64, en-US locale, using VS2015 Update 3.

Attached are the log files from buildtrees and my list of installed libraries.
[vcpkg_installed.txt](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/776980/vcpkg_installed.txt)
[config-x64-windows-rel-err.txt](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/776985/config-x64-windows-rel-err.txt)
